canonical_solution.text_md: An arrow goes from a to b exactly when $(a, b)\in R$, that is when $b = a + 2$ and both a and b belong to X.
The first pair is $(1, 3)$ and the last pair is $(6, 8)$, because a + 2 must not exceed 8.
So a takes the values $1, 2, \dots, 6$, giving 6 ordered pairs and therefore 6 arrows.
